notes: Sandbox Node was 22.23.5; bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node v24.22.3 was installed from nodejs.org into /opt/node24 (about 15 s) and used for everything.
Setup durations: bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) 4m03s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1m19s; baseline registry unit tests 4s (17/17).
The reference is a sandbox build (Ubuntu gcc 13.3.0), not the linux-x64 pin; tests assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json and pin no digest.
No linux-gated cases: integer header arithmetic and byte copies only.
